scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.ci:backend: npm run build --prefix backend && npm test --prefix backend && npm run test:integration --prefix backend
scripts.ci:frontend: npm run lint --prefix frontend && npm run test:smoke --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.ci: npm run ci:backend && npm run ci:frontend
